player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a repetitive loop between the Garage, Home gym, and Bedroom, repeatedly moving south/north and east/west without tracking which rooms I had already visited. I failed to recognize that I was revisiting the Garage and Home gym multiple times instead of exploring new directions like "west" from the Bedroom or "north" from the Garage. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms. Upon entering a room, I will immediately check if it is new; if not, I will prioritize an untried direction from the available options. I will only say "DONE" when I have confirmed that all reachable rooms have been visited and no new directions remain.
